title: Donut Song
transcription:
Donut Song

Well, I walked around the corner,
and I walked around the block,
and I walked right in to the donut shop,
and I scooped up a donut
right out of the grease,
and I handed the lady a five-cent piece.

Well, she looked at the nickel,
and she looked at me,
and she said: "This nickel's no good to
me, there's a hole in the middle
I can see right through." And I said,
"There's a hole in the donut too"
Thanks for the donut, so long!
